```{ojs}
// Alpha slider
viewof alphaValue = Inputs.range([0.01, 0.8], {
  value: 0.05,
  step: 0.005,
  label: 'Significance level α'
})
```

```{ojs}
// === Power curves for one- vs two-sided tests ===

// Domain for μ and grid
muDomain = [-4, 4]
muXs = d3.scaleLinear().domain(muDomain).ticks(401)

// Standard normal PDF/CDF helpers
SQRT2 = Math.sqrt(2)
SQRT2PI = Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)

// erf approximation (Abramowitz & Stegun 7.1.26)
erf = (x) => {
  const sign = Math.sign(x);
  x = Math.abs(x);
  const a1 = 0.254829592, a2 = -0.284496736, a3 = 1.421413741;
  const a4 = -1.453152027, a5 = 1.061405429, p = 0.3275911;
  const t = 1 / (1 + p * x);
  const y = 1 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-x*x);
  return sign * y;
}

normalCDF = (x) => 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / SQRT2))

// Inverse normal CDF (Acklam's approximation, high accuracy)
function normalInvCDF(p){
  // Coefficients
  const a = [-3.969683028665376e+01,  2.209460984245205e+02, -2.759285104469687e+02,
              1.383577518672690e+02, -3.066479806614716e+01,  2.506628277459239e+00];
  const b = [-5.447609879822406e+01,  1.615858368580409e+02, -1.556989798598866e+02,
              6.680131188771972e+01, -1.328068155288572e+01];
  const c = [-7.784894002430293e-03, -3.223964580411365e-01, -2.400758277161838e+00,
             -2.549732539343734e+00,  4.374664141464968e+00,  2.938163982698783e+00];
  const d = [ 7.784695709041462e-03,  3.224671290700398e-01,  2.445134137142996e+00,
              3.754408661907416e+00];
  // Break-points
  const plow = 0.02425, phigh = 1 - plow;
  let q, r, x;
  if (p < plow){
    q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(p));
    x = (((((c[0]*q + c[1])*q + c[2])*q + c[3])*q + c[4])*q + c[5]) /
        ((((d[0]*q + d[1])*q + d[2])*q + d[3])*q + 1);
  } else if (p > phigh){
    q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - p));
    x = -(((((c[0]*q + c[1])*q + c[2])*q + c[3])*q + c[4])*q + c[5]) /
          ((((d[0]*q + d[1])*q + d[2])*q + d[3])*q + 1);
  } else {
    q = p - 0.5; r = q*q;
    x = (((((a[0]*r + a[1])*r + a[2])*r + a[3])*r + a[4])*r + a[5]) * q /
        (((((b[0]*r + b[1])*r + b[2])*r + b[3])*r + b[4])*r + 1);
  }
  // One step of Halley refinement
  const e = normalCDF(x) - p;
  const u = e * Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI) * Math.exp(x*x/2);
  return x - u / (1 + x*u/2);
}
// Critical values based on current alpha
z_twoSided = normalInvCDF(1 - alphaValue / 2)
z_oneSided = normalInvCDF(1 - alphaValue)

// Power functions using dynamic critical values
powerTwoSided = (mu) => {
  // Power(μ) = P(|T| > z | μ) = Φ(μ - z) + Φ(-μ - z)
  return normalCDF(mu - z_twoSided) + normalCDF(-mu - z_twoSided);
}

powerOneSided = (mu) => {
  // Power(μ) = P(T > z | μ) = 1 - Φ(z - μ)
  return 1 - normalCDF(z_oneSided - mu);
}

// Build curves
twoSided = muXs.map(mu => ({ mu, y: powerTwoSided(mu), which: "Two-sided" }))
oneSided = muXs.map(mu => ({ mu, y: powerOneSided(mu), which: "One-sided" }))

// Mark the μ=0 point (both equal α)
at0 = [
  { mu: 0, y: powerTwoSided(0), which: "Two-sided" },
  { mu: 0, y: powerOneSided(0), which: "One-sided" }
]


// On-curve label anchors (choose different μ to avoid overlap)
muLabelTwo = 2.4
muLabelOne = 1.2
labelDots = [
  { mu: muLabelTwo, y: powerTwoSided(muLabelTwo), label: "Two-sided", color: "var(--plot-series-1)" },
  { mu: muLabelOne, y: powerOneSided(muLabelOne), label: "One-sided", color: "var(--plot-series-4)" }
]


```

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-power-one-vs-two
//| fig-cap: Power curves for one-sided and two-sided z-tests, testing $H_0\colon \mu = 0$ using $T\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu, 1)$. The one-sided test is more powerful in the correct direction; the two-sided test splits α across both tails.
//| fig-align: center
//| echo: false

{
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    height: 340,
    marginLeft: 52,
    marginBottom: 46,
    marginTop: 40,
    x: { label: "Effect size μ", domain: muDomain },
    y: { label: "Power", domain: [0, 1] },
    style: {
      background: "var(--plot-bg)",
      color: "var(--plot-fg)",
      fontFamily: bodyFont,
      fontSize: 12
    },
    marks: [
      // baseline and bands
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "var(--plot-grid)", strokeOpacity: 0.6 }),
      Plot.ruleY([1], { stroke: "var(--plot-grid)", strokeOpacity: 0.15 }),
      Plot.ruleY([alphaValue], { 
        stroke: "var(--plot-fg)",
        strokeWidth: 1, 
        strokeOpacity: 0.3, 
        strokeDasharray: "6,3" 
      }),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { 
        stroke: "var(--plot-fg)",
        strokeWidth: 1.5, 
        strokeOpacity: 0.35, 
        strokeDasharray: "3,3" 
      }),

      // two-sided curve & light fill
      Plot.areaY(twoSided, { 
        x: "mu", 
        y: "y", 
        fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
        fillOpacity: 0.10 
      }),
      Plot.lineY(twoSided, { 
        x: "mu", 
        y: "y", 
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
        strokeWidth: 2 
      }),

      // one-sided curve & light fill
      Plot.areaY(oneSided, { 
        x: "mu", 
        y: "y", 
        fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
        fillOpacity: 0.10 
      }),
      Plot.lineY(oneSided, { 
        x: "mu", 
        y: "y", 
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
        strokeWidth: 2 
      }),

      // points at μ=0 (both equal α)
      Plot.dot(at0, { 
        x: "mu", 
        y: "y", 
        r: 4, 
        fill: "var(--plot-fg)",
        stroke: "var(--plot-bg)",
        strokeWidth: 2
      }),
      
      // On-curve labels (placed at different μ values)
      Plot.dot(labelDots, { x: "mu", y: "y", r: 2, fill: d => d.color }),
      Plot.text(labelDots, { 
        x: "mu", y: "y", text: "label", 
        dx: -30, dy: -20, 
        fill: d => d.color, 
        fontWeight: "bold"
      }),

      
      // Alpha level annotation
      Plot.text([{x: -3.5, y: alphaValue}], {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: d => `α = ${alphaValue.toFixed(2)}`,
        dx: 0,
        dy: -8,
        fontSize: 11,
        fill: "var(--plot-fg)",
        fillOpacity: 0.7
      })
    ]
  });
  
  // Display info about current settings
  const info = html`
    <div style="margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px; background: var(--header-bg); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px;">
      <strong>Settings:</strong> α = ${alphaValue.toFixed(3)} | 
      Critical values: z<sub>${(1 - alphaValue/2).toFixed(3)}</sub> = ${z_twoSided.toFixed(3)} (two-sided), 
      z<sub>${(1 - alphaValue).toFixed(3)}</sub> = ${z_oneSided.toFixed(3)} (one-sided) |
      Power at μ=0: ${(alphaValue).toFixed(3)}
    </div>
  `;
  
  return html`<div style="width: 100%; max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto;">
    ${plot}
    ${info}
  </div>`;

}
```

// Add custom CSS for the slider styling (without the details.controls-root requirement)
html`<style>
/* Style all range sliders in the document */
input[type="range"] {
  /* Reset browser defaults */
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  
  /* Layout */
  width: 100%;
  height: 18px;
  background: transparent;
  vertical-align: middle;
  
  /* Brand theming */
  accent-color: var(--ctrl-brand);
}

/* Hide the number input box that appears with Inputs.range */
form:has(input[type="range"]) input[type="number"] {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Center the slider container */
form:has(input[type="range"]) {
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 600px; /* Adjust as needed */
  padding: 10px 0;
}

/* Slider track - WebKit */
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ctrl-brand, #667eea) 35%, transparent);
}

/* Slider thumb - WebKit */
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--ctrl-brand, #667eea);
  
  /* Center thumb over 4px track */
  margin-top: -4px;
}

/* Slider track - Firefox */
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track {
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ctrl-brand, #667eea) 35%, transparent);
}

/* Slider thumb - Firefox */
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--ctrl-brand, #667eea);
}

/* Firefox progress styling */
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-progress {
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ctrl-brand, #667eea) 35%, transparent);
}
</style>`
